notes: REPLACES AN AMOSTOOLS STUB. Until 2026-08-12 this row held only the token table with the library stripped out from under it -- both length fields zero, no code, every routine word overwritten with `====` -- so the tier could not rise above `manual`. The real library's table is IDENTICAL to the stub's, entry for entry, id for id and spec for spec, which is a check on the AMOSTools reader as much as on this registration. What changes is that the code is now here to read. Six keywords, the smallest table in the registry after Personnal EXTRA's two: `Dlcopswap`, `=Dlscreenbase(n)`, `=Dldepth(n)`, `=Dlcheckaga`, `Dlmergedisplay` (seven arguments) and `Dlscreenoffset` (three). A copper-list and display-merging helper with an AGA test, and the library's own title says "Display Library Extension v0.01 (Feb 2011) by JB" -- 2011, which makes it the youngest extension registered here by fifteen years. ITS ONLY DOCUMENTATION IS A TOOL'S DUMP, and it is better than a manual: Display_commands.txt is Andrew D Burton's Extension Examiner export, giving every header offset by name (Start 32, C_Off 50, C_Tk 68, C_Lib 202, C_Title 1696, C_End 1770), the routine map (L0 default at 202, L1 end of default at 526, L9 errors at 1606, L10 no-errors at 1682), the slot twice over, and the raw syntax strings with their terminators. That last part is an INDEPENDENT TRANSCRIPTION of the token table, so this port's reader can be checked against a second opinion rather than only against itself.
